Seasonal themed medieval sheds in Gweniaczek's style, using assets from Way Back Pelican Town, with Gwen's permission ofc. ❤️
I barely did anything, so if you're happy with the sheds please thank Gwen! 🧡

These sheds were originally designed for personal use, so they are themed with gems/animal produce, etc. If enough people request changes, I may make alternate versions, so feel free to leave feedback in the comments. 💛

I will likely release more sheds in the future (if Gwen grants permission again ofc). 💚

Currently only the recolours listed below are available, but I will release more in the future once I get through a few other mods on my goal list. 💙[i]
